caseName: State Savings & Commercial Bank v. Anderson
caseNameFull: State Savings & Commercial Bank, in Error v. Alden Anderson
summary: In error to the- Supreme Court of the State of California.
attorneys: Mr'. C. M. Jennings and Mr. Arthur Crane for the plaintiff in error. Mr. A. A. Le Idgne and Mr. U. S. Webb for the defendants in error.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam.

Judgment affirmed, with costs, upon the authority of Engel v. O’Malley, 219 U. S. 128; Noble State Bank v. Haskell, 219 U. S. 104.
